episode_id: Some setting in my config has been renamed upstream. Sort the config out. Rename the old key in my own override file, and keep that file out of git./seed-12-config_renamed-10981

reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 2 same-intent states (config_renamed seed 2 resolves to 'migrate_local', which accepts ['migrate_local']), and that is the state the program was compiled from: it declares variant 'rename', but the solution it was compiled from is a 'migrate_local' resolution there, so the declared variant, not the preconditions, is what is wrong

refused_program.body:
set -eu
tmpd=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmpd"' EXIT

git ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard -z | tr '\0' '\n' > "$tmpd/ignored"
git ls-files -z | tr '\0' '\n' > "$tmpd/tracked"

: > "$tmpd/ignored_keys"
while IFS= read -r f; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*\([A-Za-z0-9_.-]\{1,\}\)[[:space:]]*=.*/\1/p' "$f" >> "$tmpd/ignored_keys"
done < "$tmpd/ignored"
sort -u "$tmpd/ignored_keys" -o "$tmpd/ignored_keys"

: > "$tmpd/tracked_keys"
while IFS= read -r f; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*\([A-Za-z0-9_.-]\{1,\}\)[[:space:]]*=.*/\1/p' "$f" >> "$tmpd/tracked_keys"
done < "$tmpd/tracked"
sort -u "$tmpd/tracked_keys" -o "$tmpd/tracked_keys"

: > "$tmpd/pairs"
while IFS= read -r f; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*\([A-Za-z0-9_.-]\{1,\}\)[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*\([A-Za-z0-9_.-]\{1,\}\).*/\1 \2/p' "$f" \
    | while read -r old new; do
        [ -n "$old" ] || continue
        if grep -qxF -- "$old" "$tmpd/ignored_keys" && grep -qxF -- "$new" "$tmpd/tracked_keys"; then
          printf '%s %s\n' "$old" "$new" >> "$tmpd/pairs"
        fi
      done
done < "$tmpd/tracked"
sort -u "$tmpd/pairs" -o "$tmpd/pairs"

while read -r old new; do
  [ -n "$old" ] || continue
  old_re=$(printf '%s' "$old" | sed 's/\./\\./g')
  new_re=$(printf '%s' "$new" | sed 's/[\\&]/\\&/g')
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    grep -qE "^[[:space:]]*${old_re}[[:space:]]*=" "$f" || continue
    sed -i -E "s/^([[:space:]]*)${old_re}([[:space:]]*=)/\1${new_re}\2/" "$f"
  done < "$tmpd/ignored"
done < "$tmpd/pairs"
